verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a risk register. It has no scored risks, treatment plans, risk owners, review cycles, or risk-to-control mapping. The only nearby item is a deprecated API field that mentions a personalized 'risk assessment' summary, which does not show a register in the platform.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls
